card.name: The start of "intravenous" when split
card.fires_on: The piece "intr" (or "TR" in capitals) that begins the word intravenous when it is split into parts. It appears before "avenous" in anesthesia and drug-dosing text.

modes.label: Lowercase intr
modes.description: The word intravenous is split after "intr" in running text, after words like The, An or for.

modes.label: Capitalized IN-TR
modes.description: The capitalized word INTRAVENOUS is split with the marked piece "TR" inside it.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward completing the word with "a" and "ven..." pieces, i.e. the spelling "intravenous".
card.plain: It fires on the opening piece of the word intravenous, when the word is broken into parts.
